nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner; written in the Owned constructor and acceptOwnership, read by the onlyOwner modifier and transferAnyERC20Token.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed/cleared by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string, initialised to "GEE" in the token constructor.
Public token name string, initialised to "Green Earth Economy Fund" in the token constructor.
Public token decimals value, fixed to 18 in the token constructor.
Total token supply (21000000 * 10^18); read by totalSupply() and written once by the constructor.
Mapping(address => uint) of token balances; read and written by totalSupply, balanceOf, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of allowances; written by approve and approveAndCall, read by allowance and transferFrom.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): addition with require(c >= a) overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): subtraction with require(b <= a) underflow guard.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): multiplication with require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): division with require(b > 0) zero-division guard.
Owned() constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender at deployment time.
Owner-only function that stages _newOwner into the newOwner state variable.
Allows the staged newOwner, verified against msg.sender, to take ownership and clears newOwner.
Token constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals/total supply and mints the entire supply to the fixed deployer address.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using raw unchecked arithmetic.
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd on the balances mapping.
Writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens with no checks and emits Approval.
Spends allowance allowed[from][msg.sender] and moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance for spender and then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract, which may be attacker-controlled (dangerous approve+call pattern).
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
Owner-only rescue function that performs an external ERC20 transfer call on an arbitrary tokenAddress.
msg.sender used for ownership checks: owner assignment in Owned() and the require(msg.sender == owner/newOwner) guards.
msg.sender used as the account key when reading/writing the balances and allowed mappings in transfer, approve and transferFrom.
msg.sender forwarded as the 'from' argument into the external receiveApproval callback in approveAndCall.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) with an arbitrary spender contract while state is already updated.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) with an arbitrary tokenAddress.
Raw unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] outside SafeMath in totalSupply().
First operand parameter 'a' of the SafeMath helpers.
Second operand parameter 'b' of the SafeMath helpers.
Destination address parameter 'to' of transfer and transferFrom.
Amount parameter 'tokens' used by transfer, approve, transferFrom, approveAndCall and transferAnyERC20Token.
Spender address parameter of approve and approveAndCall.
Source account parameter 'from' of transferFrom.
Arbitrary bytes payload 'data' forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback.
Candidate owner address parameter '_newOwner' of transferOwnership.
Account address parameter 'tokenOwner' of balanceOf and allowance.
Arbitrary ERC20 contract address parameter of transferAnyERC20Token.
Return variable 'c' computed inside the SafeMath helpers.

edges.reason: Owned constructor writes owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership stores the candidate address in newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
Constructor sets symbol = "GEE".
Constructor sets name = "Green Earth Economy Fund".
Constructor sets decimals = 18.
Constructor sets the fixed total supply.
Constructor mints the whole supply into balances of the hardcoded address.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply() subtracts balances[address(0)] from the supply with unchecked arithmetic.
balanceOf() reads the balances mapping.
transfer() reads and writes sender/recipient balances.
approve() writes the allowed mapping for msg.sender and spender.
transferFrom() moves balances of from and to.
transferFrom() decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance() reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token passes the owner address as the transfer recipient.
transfer() invokes safeSub for the sender balance update.
transfer() invokes safeAdd for the recipient balance update.
transferFrom() invokes safeSub for balance and allowance updates.
transferFrom() invokes safeAdd for the recipient balance update.
approveAndCall performs an external call to an arbitrary spender contract.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an attacker-supplied token contract.
totalSupply() performs a raw subtraction without SafeMath overflow/underflow protection.
owner is derived directly from the untrusted msg.sender during construction.
The token constructor implicitly runs Owned(), setting owner from msg.sender.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender to owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
transfer() uses msg.sender as the balance account key to debit.
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
transferFrom() uses msg.sender as the spender key in the allowed mapping.
msg.sender is forwarded as 'from' into the untrusted receiveApproval callback.
The spender contract's receiveApproval can re-enter the token contract after the allowance was already written.
The arbitrary token contract can call back into transferAnyERC20Token during the external transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: Arithmetic operand a only exists as an input to the SafeMath helper set; it collapses into the helper function node.
Arithmetic operand b only exists as an input to the SafeMath helper set; it collapses into the helper function node.
The recipient parameter 'to' has no independent behaviour and folds into the core transfer function that uses it.
The amount parameter 'tokens' is a transient argument of the token transfer entry points and merges into the core transfer function.
The spender parameter is only a mapping key for allowance bookkeeping and folds into the core approve function.
The source account parameter 'from' is only meaningful inside the transferFrom bookkeeping logic.
The bytes payload parameter is only forwarded to the external callback and folds into the core approveAndCall function.
The candidate owner parameter is stored directly in newOwner and merges into the core transferOwnership function.
The queried account parameter is a passive read key and folds into the core balanceOf view function.
The external token address parameter only parameterises the external call and merges into the core rescue function.
The local result variable c exists only to hold SafeMath helper return values and merges into the core safeAdd function.
